verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud's Serverless/Basic tier documents automatic request-unit scaling, including scale-to-zero on inactivity, which aligns with autoscaling compute without manual resizing. However, evidence is thin on how it scales up under load or guarantees against downtime, and CockroachDB's core distributed architecture (self-hosted) generally requires manual node provisioning for scaling, so this capability is specific to the managed cloud tier only. missing for 10: detailed scale-up mechanics/limits, evidence of zero-downtime during scale events, independent/hands-on confirmation of autoscaling behavior under real load.
